pending: The 1802.1.3 build's fluid amount consumed per drop and timing are not documented; the current 250 mB and default 100-tick interval are Horizon tuning pending direct comparison.
Chance rolls use a persisted per-Dripper generator, not the vanilla world RNG; the host API has no general server-side random sample for machine ticks.

A source fluid block directly above the Dripper fills the tank; other fluids can enter through Horizon's machine fluid capability. The 1.18.2 bucket/bowl interaction and exact fluid input behavior have not been confirmed against the original mod.
The pack's nine probabilistic recipes are simulated but are not exposed to recipe viewers because the current machine recipe API rejects its documented chance output syntax.
Pack recipes use compressed StoneBlock blocks and oil-sand outputs from other mods; those dependencies are not all ported or available in the isolated FTB Dripper fixture.
The original custom textures are excluded under the source mod's All Rights Reserved license; current models use vanilla stone and stick textures. Redistribution permission is not recorded.
